name: com.nekuzaky.hindsight
description: Rewind debugger for the Unity Editor. Hindsight records your scene while you play, so when something goes wrong you pause, drag the timeline back and see every object exactly as it was, with errors, bookmarks, velocities and your own variables on the timeline. Editor only: nothing ships in your builds.

samples.description: A small 2D scene where balls bounce, spawn and sometimes fall through the floor. Press Play, wait for the red error marker, pause and rewind to it.
